title: Moment Restrictions for Nonlinear Panel Data Models with Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2506.12569v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many panel data methods, while allowing for general dependence between covariates and time-invariant agent-specific heterogeneity, place strong a priori restrictions on feedback: how past outcomes, covariates, and heterogeneity map into future covariate levels. Ruling out feedback entirely, as often occurs in practice, is unattractive in many dynamic economic settings. We provide a general characterization of all feedback and heterogeneity robust (FHR) moment conditions for nonlinear panel data models and present constructive methods to derive feasible moment-based estimators for specific models. We characterize semiparametric efficiency bounds in this case, quantifying the information loss associated with accommodating feedback as well as providing insight into how to construct estimators with good efficiency properties in practice. translated_title: 带反馈的非线性面板数据模型的矩约束条件
translated_abstract: 许多面板数据方法虽然允许协变量与不随时间变化的个体特定异质性之间存在一般性的依赖关系，但对“反馈”施加了较强的先验限制，即过去的结果、协变量和异质性如何映射到未来的协变量水平。在实践中常见的完全排除反馈的做法，在许多动态经济环境中并不具有吸引力。我们为非线性面板数据模型提供了对所有反馈与异质性稳健（FHR）矩条件的一般性刻画，并提出了针对特定模型推导可行的基于矩的估计量的构造性方法。我们在该情形下刻画了半参数效率边界，量化了为容纳反馈而产生的信息损失，并为如何在实践中构造具有良好效率性质的估计量提供了洞见。当FHR矩条件点识别目标参数时——这也是我们重点强调的情形——我们证明它们达到了（半参数效率边界）。
tldr: 本文为非线性面板数据模型给出了所有“反馈与异质性稳健”（FHR）矩条件的一般性刻画，提供了构造可行矩估计量的方法，刻画了半参数效率边界，并证明在点识别情形下FHR矩条件可以达到该效率边界。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a general characterization of all feedback-and-heterogeneity-robust (FHR) moment conditions for nonlinear panel data models, offers constructive methods for deriving feasible moment-based estimators, characterizes the semiparametric efficiency bounds, and shows that FHR moments attain the efficiency bound under point identification.
